messages:
Alex P: Heads up — noticed a ~3x invoice-preview spike for tenant acme-corp between 02:03-02:07 UTC. Dashboard shows huge token drops on routing-tag 'eu-fallback'. Anyone on the rollout path?

metering-bot: [ALERT] high-volume billing events detected for routing-tag=eu-fallback, agg_tokens=1.2M (↑300%), window=5m. alert_id=mb-8942

Maria S: looking now. pulling ingest logs + fingerprint mapping. quick check: is this the hysteresis tweak we put in last night?

Kevin T: yup that's the new hysteresis policy. We added a 15s sticky period before re-evaluating fallback which may double-fire in slow ACK paths.

Alex P: hmm double-fire -> duplicate billing events? I thought we dedup on event_id + fingerprint. Could that change the fingerprint window semantics?

Maria S: possible. duplicate pattern looks like: same session_id, two routing_tags emitted ~3s apart, both landed in streaming-ingest before dedupe window started. snippet from logs: 
```
2026-02-18T02:04:11Z INFO emit_event tenant=acme session=abc123 route=eu-fallback token_count=432
2026-02-18T02:04:14Z INFO emit_event tenant=acme session=abc123 route=primary token_count=432
```

Pat - Billing: if duplicates hit invoice-preview customers might see inflated estimates. We need to know scope (how many tenants) before we consider credits. Can we identify and rollback?

Kevin T: quick triage: looks constrained to eu region proxies + eu-fallback. I can push a hotfix to make the hysteresis check compare last_emitted_route instead of re-emitting if within 10s. That should stop the race.

Ingrid (SRE): recommend pausing the rollout for the policy and scaling back canary to 0% until fix. Also we should backfill dedupe for affected window.

Maria S: I have a query to find duplicates by (tenant, session, event_hash) across a 30s sliding window. Running it now, but results might take ~4m for the 2h retention shard: 
```
SELECT tenant, session_id, event_hash, count(*) as ct
FROM metering.events_v2
WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-02-18T01:50:00Z' AND '2026-02-18T02:10:00Z'
AND route LIKE '%fallback%'
GROUP BY 1,2,3
HAVING ct > 1
```

Alex P: good. If duplicates are <=50 tenants we can do targeted invoice-preview adjustments. If more, Pat, we might want a blanket temporary UI note + automatic preview credits.

Pat - Billing: agree. I'll draft a short notif for Console: "Invoice preview may overestimate usage for requests between 02:03-02:07 UTC due to routing fallback hiccup; we are investigating and applying corrections where needed." Also need an internal flag so we don't auto-bill previews as final.

Kevin T: hotfix ready, running unit + staging canary now. If green, I'll promote and then roll back hysteresis rollout. ETA 25m.

Ingrid (SRE): I'll pause the rollout and shove a canary override to 0% now. Also adding a short-term metric: duplicate_event_ratio by route to alert if >0.1% for 5m.

Maria S: query finished — looks like 18 tenants affected, mostly medium-volume accounts. Exporting CSV to /tmp/dupes-1789991111.csv and pushing to #eng-platform-private with ACL.

Alex P: thanks. Action list: Kevin promote hotfix -> Ingrid confirm canary paused -> Maria provide tenant list -> Pat prepare console message & credit plan. I'll follow up with finance if credits needed.

Pat - Billing: noted. Ping me when tenant list is in Slack and I'll start draft.

metering-bot: [INFO] mitigation_in_progress for alert mb-8942. tags=[hysteresis-hotfix, canary-paused].

Alex P: closing loop: once hotfix is live let's run the dedupe backfill and then run end-to-end invoice-preview sanity check. Who owns backfill?

Maria S: I'll own backfill exec. Plan: run dedupe PL that de-duplicates by event_hash for the affected time window and emit correction events (negative tokens). ETA 2h after hotfix.

Kevin T: hotfix deployed to prod canary at 02:28 UTC, no further duplicate bursts in last 10m of sampling. rolling to 100% over 15m.

Ingrid (SRE): monitoring dashboard shows duplicate_event_ratio falling to baseline. keeping the canary override until corrections run.

Alex P: thanks all — great rapid collab. We'll keep the Console note up until backfills finish.
